text.tspan: Things I built along the way
Online ordering for a college food stall: menu, Razorpay payments
with webhook verification and server-side pricing, and an admin
LPC2148 clock + countdown: date/day, 12/24 h, alarm with
snooze, hourly chime, stopwatch with laps, pot-set countdown via
ADC, 1 ms timer base. Team of 3.
Wi-Fi robot car with MJPEG live video, browser dashboard control
MediaPipe 21-point hand tracking with geometric rules for 11
robot commands (stop, follow, turn, speed). No training needed;
sends commands over serial; runs headless on the UNO Q.
Multi-sensor node (LDR, rain, soil moisture) streaming live readings
to a Blynk dashboard for remote monitoring. Team of 4.
Real-time OpenCV pipeline: adaptive grayscale for low-contrast
scenes and pixel-intensity histograms feeding an offline AI model
n8n workflow where an LLM classifies feedback as complaint,
compliment or suggestion, routes it to the right team, logs it in
Airtable and sends a reply email.
My first desktop voice assistant with a HUD-style GUI, voice
input/output and safety protocols. What I learned from it shaped
Team lead and CAD designer at the Autodesk 36-hour hackathon
Hand-written HTML/CSS/JS with a Three.js particle scene that
morphs per section, GSAP scroll animations and smooth scrolling.
